channel.title: Saint Gordon Collective — Writings
channel.description: Studio notes, mix breakdowns, release diaries, and essays from Saint Gordon Collective.

item.title: Analogue vs Digital EQ: Cut With a Scalpel, Boost With Iron
item.description: When to reach for surgical digital EQ versus broad Pultec and Neve curves, common mud and presence zones, and how a 4 kHz guitar dip opens up crowded vocals.

item.title: Parallel Compression: All Buttons In and Why Rhythm Matters
item.description: How to pin vocals and drums upfront using UAD 1176 All Buttons mode, why you keep the send locked at 0 dB, and why unrelated rhythms destroy a shared crush bus.

item.title: The Only Two Compressors You Actually Need
item.description: Why ditching menu heavy digital compressors for the UAD 1176 and Teletronix LA2A streamlines every vocal and bass mix, plus which UAD bundles actually include both.

item.title: Stop Mastering to -14 LUFS
item.description: Why chasing Spotify normalization leaves masters thin, where modern commercial records actually sit between -12 and -8 LUFS, and the exact EQ and compression chain order.

item.title: The Zero Dollar Plugin Rack
item.description: A complete, zero cost mixing and mastering plugin rack pairing proven freeware classics with CRQL ANINA spectral resonance suppression.

item.title: Pre Mix & Pre Master Bounce Hygiene
item.description: The tracking gain, headroom, sample rate, and export checks that prevent ruined vocal stems and clipped bounces before mixing or mastering begins.

item.title: Why Mixes Fall Apart in the Car
item.description: Why studio speakers fool your ears after hours in a session, and how one simple reference track workflow keeps your mix translating everywhere.

item.title: The Abbey Road Reverb Trick
item.description: How a 1960s EMI echo chamber workaround, cutting lows at 600 Hz and highs at 10 kHz, keeps modern reverbs and delays deep, lush, and free of mud.
